preferences.name: defaultType
preferences.title: Default Type
preferences.description: What to generate when no type is chosen

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: Copy honors the Clipboard settings below. Paste types into the frontmost app, but may be recorded by clipboard managers.

preferences.name: clearClipboardAfter
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.description: Clear a copied value from the clipboard after this delay, unless something else was copied since

preferences.name: universalClipboard
preferences.label: Use Universal Clipboard to copy to other devices
preferences.description: Allow Handoff to sync copied values to your other Apple devices

preferences.name: concealClipboard
preferences.label: Hide copied values from clipboard history
preferences.description: Mark copies as concealed so Raycast and other clipboard managers don't record them. Turn off to find throwaway passwords in clipboard history later.

preferences.name: passwordLength
preferences.title: Password Length
preferences.description: Number of characters in generated passwords (minimum 8)

preferences.name: includeUppercase
preferences.label: Uppercase letters
preferences.description: Include at least one uppercase letter

preferences.name: includeLowercase
preferences.label: Lowercase letters
preferences.description: Include at least one lowercase letter

preferences.name: passphraseWords
preferences.title: Passphrase Words
preferences.description: Number of words in generated passphrases

preferences.name: passphraseDelimiter
preferences.title: Passphrase Delimiter
preferences.description: Single character placed between passphrase words (leave empty for none)

preferences.name: uppercaseWords
preferences.title: Uppercase Words
preferences.description: Number of passphrase words written in UPPERCASE

preferences.name: customWordlist
preferences.title: Custom Word List
preferences.description: Optional file with one word per line. Defaults to the EFF large word list.

preferences.name: pinLength
preferences.title: PIN Length
preferences.description: Number of digits in generated PINs
